Sam (Product): Quick async check — Q2 milestone rollup. Drop a one-line: owner, shipped/slipped, key dep/action. I'll compile and send to leadership by EOD.

Alex (Eng - Runtime): runtime-v2.3 rollout — shipped to prod yesterday. Owner: Alex. Latency SLO ✅. Observed small mem leak on long seqs, tracking in #eng-runtime. PR in progress.

Maria (Eng - Platform): Dedicated autoscaler — slipped. Owner: Maria. Blocker: cloud GPU quota approval stuck with infra vendor. Filed INFRA-118. ETA ~+2w if quota not bumped.

Jordan (Eng - SRE): Observability retention parity — metrics shipped, logs retention slipped. Owner: Jordan. Need schema sign-off before log-agent rollout. Rolling update scheduled once approved.

Lee (PM): Smart-routing policy (canary -> global) — partial. Owner: Lee. Canary passed traffic/latency checks but hit throttling in some edge regions. Paused rollout; requires runtime toggle support from Alex.

Nina (Eng - ML): Model quant profiles — mostly shipped. Owner: Nina. Llama-variant regressed in perf after quantization, slipped. Investigating quant config, running A/B experiments. ETA ~4d. Link: https://go/quant-exp

Sam (Product): Notes: Maria, infra quota is highest priority. Jordan, hold on logs until schema confirmed. @Lee please add the runtime toggle request to Alex's backlog.

Alex (Eng - Runtime): Added toggle task to runtime backlog and opened a small patch. Will test canary toggle flow. PR: https://git.redwood/rt/PR456

Maria (Eng - Platform): Question — do we want temporary burst capacity as a mitigation if quota delay continues? I can draft the change and cost estimate.

Lee (PM): Yes please. Temporary burst would be ideal if infra gives short-term approval. That buys time for autoscaler work.

Jordan (Eng - SRE): Logs schema ready. Will paste delta in thread and run a small staging rollout.

Alex (Eng - Runtime): Quick deploy command I used for canary: `./deploy.sh --canary runtime-v2.3` — toggles are behind feature flags now.

deploy-bot: Deployment completed: runtime-v2.3 — task id dpl-872 @1765432195

Sam (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll assemble this into the Q2 milestone board and ping execs after noon. If anything else is going to slip, ping me by 15:00. :calendar: :thumbsup:
